spec.headline: “Contagion is not an inevitable market force. It is an architectural failure.”

blocks.text: Segregated accounts natively enforce token whitelists and transfer rules without wrappers, confining distress to the source.
Structural isolation versus collective pool risk

focal.reason: Explains the architectural mechanism of segregated accounts that prevents contagion.

defects.issue: Unbalanced negative space across right and lower canvas
defects.reason: All content is clustered in the top-left column, leaving more than half the canvas completely dead and empty. This creates a severe weight imbalance rather than deliberate negative space.
defects.fix: Widen the container column from ~750px to 880px, increase vertical line spacing and font size across the quote and body copy, and vertically center the core message block within the frame.

defects.issue: Focal hierarchy failure on designated primary element
defects.location: Middle-left body copy ('Segregated accounts natively enforce...')
defects.reason: The intended focal element (block #0) reads as weak secondary body copy, completely overpowered by the 3-line bold headline quote above it.
defects.fix: Elevate block #0 by increasing its type size to at least 32px with higher text contrast, or encase it within a subtle institutional border/card container to draw primary visual weight.

defects.issue: Orphaned footer metadata with excessive vertical gap
defects.reason: A dead vertical gap of nearly 400px separates the metadata string from the preceding text, causing it to feel disconnected and floating.
defects.fix: Move the bottom metadata string up by 180px or anchor it into a consistent bottom utility bar with a subtle divider line.
